name: Nigerian Yoruba commercial video-film production
description: A Nigerian video-film pathway linked local performers and cassette traders to production for home-video circulation.

impact.note: A cassette-based production route for one region's audiences; a cheaper way to make and sell drama, from which the Nigerian video-film industry grew.

date.basis: Dated publication, legal decision, institution or documented practice; not a global origin claim.

events.statement: Kenneth Nnebue and theatre practitioner Ishola Ogunsola made the Yoruba video film Aje Ni Iya Mi.
events.scope: This documented community and episode; not a universal first.

evidence.supports: The thesis, citing Haynes, describes the 1989 collaboration and video equipment.
